title: Carve Session Duration by Surface Type
dataSources: Rides (`ride:session`), charge sessions (`ride:charge`), ride exports (`ride:export`), surf forecasts (`surf:forecast`), ride incidents (`ride:incident`), segment efforts (`fitness:segment`).
app: Micro-mobility and action-sports telemetry — Onewheel ride exports, legacy Boosted board logs, Surfline forecast snapshots, and Strava segment efforts — streamed to Splunk HEC via vendor exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ride:session surface_type=* session_duration_min=*
| stats avg(session_duration_min) as avg_session_duration_min, count as events by surface_type
| sort - avg_session_duration_min
description: Shows average session duration minutes by surface type for carve sessions.
value: Average session duration minutes by surface type helps compare carve sessions across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `session_duration_min` on `ride:session` events and normalize `surface_type` so Splunk can summarize performance by surface type.
visualization: Bar chart of average session duration minutes by surface type.
grandmaExplanation: It frames the average session duration minutes for each surface type so you can see what works best for carve sessions.
